context:
Introduce a dedicated marker for table-format-dependent tests, apply it to
Delta/Iceberg presorted integration checks, and register the marker in both
pytest configuration locations. Then add a focused CI job that installs the
required optional dependencies and runs only marker-selected tests.

Keep dependency-based skip guards in tests for local ergonomics, but ensure at
least one required CI path always has dependencies installed so these tests are
executed.
description:
Ensure Delta and Iceberg integration assertions for presorted dataset generation
are executed consistently in CI rather than being silently skipped when optional
dependencies are missing.

The current tests are dependency-gated and can pass in environments that do not
install deltalake/pyiceberg, which leaves a regression blind spot for open table
format output paths.

This item adds explicit marker-based selection, a dedicated CI job that installs
table-format dependencies, and contributor documentation so coverage is durable
and understandable.

anti_patterns.dont: bundle this into unrelated CI jobs
anti_patterns.instead: keep a dedicated table-format integration job

anti_patterns.dont: move deltalake/pyiceberg into core runtime dependencies
anti_patterns.instead: install them in CI via dev group or table-formats extras
use marker-scoped CI execution to guarantee coverage
anti_patterns.why: local environments may intentionally lack optional deps
